property_summary: For any caller address A that is a Bank supporting the token, if A initially has zero tokenBalance then calling airDrop from A increases tokenBalance(A) by 20 in the reference — the mutant (which requires non-zero balance) will not, so there exists an address A (with initial zero balance) where tokenBalance differs after airDrop.
change_summary: Invert hasNoBalance to require that the caller already has a positive balance, changing which callers can receive the airdrop.
